_source: Zambian OBC 2013 Religious Education (2044), Grade 11 — subject code 'RE2044'. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 (superseding this file's earlier same-day version, whose sub-topics were too coarse to match the app's 30 pre-existing real embedded lesson plans) from a real, complete Google Drive document, 'RE 2044 SCHEMES OF WORK 10-12.docx' — a genuine week-by-week Scheme of Work covering all three grades and terms, from a real Zambian secondary school (a different real school from the other RE 2044 lesson-plan source). Real PII stripped, per standing sourcing policy: the document's final line credited a real named individual and named the source school/town/province; none of that appears anywhere in this file. Topic name 'Life' is kept exactly as this app's pre-existing 30 real embedded lesson plans already use it, with sub-topics now broken down at the same fine grain those lesson plans use ('Happiness in Present Situation', etc — two of the ten 'Life' lesson plans use slightly different real wording than the pattern, 'Ideas about life after death in the Church' and 'Teachings about death in the Old Testament', both reproduced here verbatim to match), so all 10 of that topic's real lesson plans reconnect directly. Term 1 opens in the source with a real review/carryover of Grade 10's own 'Service' sub-topics (Old/New Testament, weeks 2-4) before this grade's own 'Life' theme begins at week 5 — that real content and its week data is recorded under religious_education_2044_grade10.json instead (matching the lesson plans' own Grade-10 labeling for those two lessons), not duplicated here; see that file's _source note for the full explanation. 'Man and Woman' (Term 2-3) is new real content the lesson plans don't cover, kept at the source document's own coarser granularity since no lesson-plan match depends on it. Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was first introduced (not every week it was reviewed); 'Family Life' genuinely continues into Grade 12 Term 1 in the source — a real cross-grade continuation, not duplicated here (see religious_education_2044_grade12.json). References are copied verbatim from the source's own REFERENCES column for each sub-topic's introducing week.
